nodes.title: Load Background (only when not generating one)
Stage B — composite the product in
How to use
widgets_values:
## Ad creative

Two stages. Stage A paints the ad — background, layout, and your headline text. Stage B drops the real product into it.

**1.** Put your headline in stage A's *text* prompt along with the scene, e.g. "minimalist poster, soft gradient background, the words 'SUMMER SALE 30% OFF' in bold sans-serif across the top third".

**2.** Upload your product photo in *Load Product Image*.

**3.** Queue the prompt. The result saves as `ecom_creative_00001_.png`.

### Starting from a shot you already have

Set *Use generated layout* to false and upload your own background in *Load Background*. Stage A is then skipped entirely — its inputs are lazy, so it costs no generation time, not just a discarded result.

### Speed

Stage A ships at 50 steps, undistilled, for the best typography. Flip *Enable 4 Steps LoRA?* inside stage A to switch to the 4-step Lightning path — roughly 12x faster, with softer text. It drives the sampler steps and cfg together, so there is nothing else to change.

### On the text

Stage A writes the copy; stage B does not re-render it. Keep headlines short and put the exact words in quotes. Long paragraphs still garble — check every character before you publish, especially prices and percentages.

nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values: A clean product advertisement poster. Soft peach-to-cream gradient background, generous empty space in the lower half where a product will sit. The words "SUMMER SALE" in large bold sans-serif across the top, and "30% OFF" directly beneath it in a lighter weight. Studio lighting, crisp typography.

nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Negative Prompt)
widgets_values: low resolution, blurry or distorted text, misspelled words, watermark, cluttered composition, busy background where the product should sit

Place the product from image 2 into the empty area of image 1, matching its perspective, scale, light direction and shadows so it sits naturally in the layout. Keep the product's shape, colour and label text unchanged, and do not alter the existing text in image 1.

nodes.title: Note: KSampler settings
widgets_values:
You can test and find the best setting by yourself. The following table is for reference.
| Parameters   | Qwen Team | Comfy Original | with 4steps LoRA |
|--------|---------|------------|---------------------------|
| Steps  | 50      | 20         | 4                         |
| CFG    | 4.0     | 2.5        | 1.0                       |
